rationale: The only open item left in this run is gap 1ec42e5bd80546ba910c8d8d7321fd6f-gap-1: the extended-window harness reported the demoted node's own configuration view as still holding a vote at setup in two executions, while every construction that samples that view together with the node's own log index converges within one 20ms sample. Both of those executions came from the same fixed experiment, and the discriminating harness that fails to reproduce the field is a different harness, so the cheapest decisive step is to execute that exact fixed experiment once more from its retained inputs: a third sample of the same field under the same construction on the same executor distinguishes a systematic property of that harness from a two-run coincidence, and it costs one execution rather than a new harness. The repeat also gives a third independent sample of the lease-window result for the settled claim, whose interpretation stays the question's current account.
